paper.title: Agent-World: Scaling Real-World Environment Synthesis for Evolving General Agent Intelligence
paper.central_claim: Agent-World通过真实环境主题的数据库/工具/可验证任务合成(Agentic Environment-Task Discovery)与多环境RL+自演化竞技场(诊断能力缺口→定向任务合成→继续RL)，使Agent-World-8B/14B在23个基准上超过强基线，并呈现环境数量与演化轮数的扩展趋势。

provenance.notes: Opus aggregate seat via the configured claude-kimi type fable; no route probing. actual_model/session_id/receipt_ref are null because the subagent runtime exposes no verifiable provider receipt to this worker.

sections_read: Opus: §1–6 read in full before opening seat records, plus Appendix 7 (diagnosis prompt), Appendix 8 (environment cards, skimmed) and the Appendix 9 remnant
missing_sections: Appendix 9 Case Study: the text stops after the '9.1 Case 1: Ecomm MCP Server' heading and the arXiv LaTeXML footer follows (HTML-conversion truncation, opus:O04)
Appendix 7 'Table 7' output schema referenced but absent from the HTML (opus:O05 context)
materials.note: Verified extraction loss, not an author omission. arxiv.org/pdf/2604.18292v1 exists (48 pages; its outline lists Appendix C 'Case Study' with 'Case 1: Ecomm MCP Server' and 'Case 3: Population Data Server'), so the content is recoverable from the official PDF. The PDF was opened once only to check this, is not cited as evidence and is not part of the pinned input. No request is raised because the A3 disposition depends only on §3.2, Algorithm 1, §4.1 and §4.3, which are complete.

evidence.quote: We present three representative trajectories with at least 7 interaction turns. For each case, we report the environment context, task requirement, tool inventory, rubric criteria, and an abbreviated interaction trajectory.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者明确说将呈现三个至少7轮的案例；所给文本在9.1标题后立即进入HTML渲染footer，无法核读这些案例。此处仅记录材料核验阻塞，不判作者没做。

evidence.quote: which combines multi-environment reinforcement learning with a self-evolving agent arena that automatically identifies capability gaps through dynamic task synthesis and drives targeted learning
evidence.support_explanation: 第二组件的中心操作：用RL(更新策略)与竞技场诊断驱动定向学习；学习发生在权重。

evidence.quote: we perform multi-environment agent RL to improve state-aware reasoning, long-horizon tool use, and environment interaction robustness
evidence.support_explanation: 改进手段是对策略的RL训练(GRPO)，目标是策略的能力。

evidence.quote: After cold-start SFT, we initialize the Qwen3-8B/14B backbones
evidence.support_explanation: 被评价与发布的对象是SFT+GRPO训练后的Qwen3-8B/14B权重。

evidence.quote: finally, targeted synthesis and continual RL produce the next-round policy
evidence.support_explanation: 每轮的留存产物是下一轮策略权重；合成任务/诊断指南用于继续RL的训练数据，实验未评价环境库或诊断指南作为推理期非权重组件的效果。

evidence.locator: Sec 3.1 Tool Interface Generation and Verification
evidence.quote: A tool is retained only if it satisfies all of the following:
evidence.support_explanation: 环境内工具经单测过滤后保留，是执行门控的合成环境资产；但这些工具属于训练环境，不是被训练智能体在评测基准中使用的harness组件。

evidence.quote: we adopt Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) [ grpo ] to directly maximize the verifiable returns defined above
evidence.support_explanation: The learning update is GRPO on the policy weights.

evidence.quote: we then perform multi-environment agent RL (Sec. 3.2.1 ) on the augmented data to obtain an improved policy
evidence.support_explanation: Diagnosis-targeted tasks are 'augmented data' for continued RL; the product of each round is a policy.

evidence.quote: finally, targeted synthesis and continual RL produce the next-round policy
evidence.support_explanation: The self-evolution gains in Table 2 are gains of successive trained policies.

evidence.quote: We present three representative trajectories with at least 7 interaction turns.
evidence.support_explanation: Only the preamble and the 9.1 heading survive in the pinned HTML, after which the LaTeXML 'build logs' footer begins. This confirms sol's material finding as an HTML conversion loss.

evidence.quote: This arena-driven loop turns scalable environments into an automated curriculum engine
evidence.support_explanation: The authors themselves cast the environments and tasks as a training curriculum.

signatures.object: 策略权重(Qwen3-8B/14B)与由GPT-OSS-120B合成的环境/任务/验证脚本训练数据
signatures.information: 诊断代理可见失败轨迹、按环境/类别的错误统计、环境元数据。
signatures.operation: 评测→诊断出弱环境与任务生成指南→定向合成任务(可含数据库复杂化)→继续GRPO训练。
signatures.conditions: 可执行验证器/量规；留出的竞技场环境每轮动态刷新。
signatures.feedback: 沙箱执行、可执行验证脚本或量规LLM判官的奖励。
signatures.selection_rule: 任务合成时ReAct代理5次求解、至少2次一致才保留；工具Acc>0.5保留。
signatures.selection_data: 合成数据的内部一致性过滤；无对策略版本的接受/回退门控。
signatures.persistence: 权重继承；环境/任务库跨轮保留为训练数据。

gap.author_gap: 真实感环境缺乏可扩展合成；现有工作偏重环境构建，缺少用环境诊断智能体弱点并驱动持续自我改进的机制。
gap.closest_adjacent: EnvScaler、ScaleEnv、AWM等环境合成基线(论文内有数值比较)；未展开。

rs_pattern.reason: Not identified: out_of_scope weight-training paper; neither seat ran the 15+31 identification and none is required for an excluded row. It is not recorded as outside_taxonomy. No score effect.

matches.condition_checks: 仅作范围参考：诊断驱动、执行验证的任务合成确实出现，但被改进对象是权重，卡片本身标注边界；不据此计分。

claims.text: 环境合成+自演化RL训练使8B/14B策略在23个基准上超过强基线，并随环境数量与演化轮数扩展。
claims.setting: Qwen3-8B/14B，SFT冷启动+GRPO，GPT-OSS-120B合成环境/任务；8次重复取平均。
claims.baseline_control: EnvScaler/ScaleEnv/AWM等环境扩展基线、开源/专有基础模型。
claims.allowed_conclusion: 范围外：不对该主张的有效性评分；仅记录其改进对象是权重。

G.reason: out_of_scope (rubric A3; EVIDENCE.md excludes weight-updating self-improvement). Independently checked: the policy is updated with GRPO on synthesized environments (opus:O01), and each self-evolution round ends by continuing RL to obtain the next policy (opus:O02, opus:O03) from SFT-initialised Qwen3-8B/14B backbones (son55:E003). The diagnosis guidelines, environments and targeted tasks are curriculum data consumed by that training (opus:O05). They are not a prompt, skill, tool or memory read by the evaluated agent at test time, and the 23 benchmarks evaluate the trained checkpoints. Not scored; null is a disposition, not a zero-quality rating.

resolutions.reason: Null is the run's canonical value for an excluded weight-level row. son55's 'not_assessed' is non-canonical.

Informational, per run convention for excluded curriculum papers (r13a H22). The diagnosis agent ranks weak environments and writes task-generation guidelines (§3.2.2), and targeted tasks are synthesised and verified for further training. That is H23's (diagnostic signal, verifier) pair; the card itself is marked as a weight boundary.

A3: the improver's update object and product are both weights (opus:O01–O03). The retained 'arena' artefacts are training data, not an evaluated non-weight component (opus:O05). sol's needs_fulltext finding is confirmed (opus:O04: HTML truncation after 9.1; Table 7 missing). It is an extraction loss recoverable from the PDF, but the missing case trajectories and output schema cannot change what is trained and evaluated, so they do not block the disposition.

shared_error_corrections.reason: The paper's evaluated product is trained policy checkpoints (an environment-synthesis + RL training recipe). Run precedent for excluded weight-training rows (r13a MM-Zero).
Claim support is not assessed for an excluded row, so null is canonical (precedent r09b GenEnv, r11a, r12b, r13a).

aggregate_review.initial_judgment_before_seat_scores: Read the abstract, §1–4 and Algorithm 1 first. Qwen3 backbones are SFT-initialised then GRPO-trained; the arena loop diagnoses, synthesises targeted tasks and continues RL → out_of_scope (A3). Then checked the appendices: Appendix 9 is truncated and Table 7 is absent.

This is a seat-level material description error, not a version mismatch, and needs no controller action.
